title: Nurse Tomás (clinic nurse)
description: Persona: a nurse at a community clinic who vaccinates, issues certificates, and records consent for patients who ask for help with the wallet. Fictional.

persona.name: Nurse Tomás
persona.goal: Issue certificates that are accepted wherever his patients go, without extra paperwork.
needs: To record a patient's consent in one step, and show it back to them
To know a certificate was issued correctly
frustrations: Patients who were never asked what they agreed to
